purpose: low-context cost-aware routing for agents, parallel work and local models

cost_classes.local: no per-call hosted API fee; local compute and licensing still matter
cost_classes.included: uses a plan or credit bucket; verify current allowance
cost_classes.unknown: do not assume cost until verified

prefer: host-native PR/check-suite subscription that resumes the same session
event_driven_ci_continuation.rule: never add timer/polling fallback while a live completion subscription exists; persist state before yielding

documentation_consistency.rule: do not use a hosted LLM worker for documentation consistency by default; use one only for a residual semantic question that survives deterministic checks and passes the hosted delegation ROI gate

delegation_trigger.must_consider_when: task has at least 3 independent bounded workstreams and at least 2 can execute without shared mutable state
delegation_trigger.must_delegate_when: after decomposition, at least 2 bounded workstreams remain independent AND at least one ready no-model/local worker route can execute a slice with deterministic verification
allowed_skip_reasons: no ready no-model/local worker route is available
worker setup/coordination cost is credibly greater than the bounded task
workstreams share mutable state that cannot be isolated
the only remaining worker option is hosted and it does not pass the hosted delegation ROI gate
delegation_trigger.insufficient_skip_reason: shared project context alone is not sufficient; first carve out bounded read-only workstreams
delegation_trigger.decision_rule: prefer none/local workers. Never spawn a hosted subagent merely to satisfy delegation. Hosted delegation requires the ROI gate below.

trace_rule.minimum_records: one record per routing/delegation decision that materially changes execution
trace_rule.sink: project audit/final report; use an existing durable audit/log surface when one exists
trace_rule.completion_rule: a whole-project qualification report is incomplete until required trace records are emitted

all_required: deterministic/static tooling cannot answer the residual question
no qualified local worker is ready or the local worker failed the task-specific quality gate
the subtask has a narrow immutable input packet and explicit output contract
expected hosted-worker token/context cost is materially lower than keeping the work in the coordinator
the worker output will be independently verified before it affects a PASS or code change

worker_context_budget.rule: send the smallest relevant packet, not repository-wide context
worker_context_budget.default_packet: exact question + relevant diff/hunks + at most 5 directly relevant files
worker_context_budget.escalation: if the task needs broader context, split the task, use deterministic retrieval, use a local worker, or keep it in the coordinator; exceed the default only with a recorded ROI rationale

worker_output_budget.rule: request findings/evidence only; no broad recap or duplicated project summary

hosted_delegation_roi_gate.stop_rule: if a hosted worker produces low-confidence or unverified findings, do not launch another hosted worker for the same slice; fall back to deterministic/coordinator verification
